[sad:low] empty beds feel quiet. bzzz. we can fill them together.

[happy:low] then sunflowers go first, for your grandpa. bzzz. tall and yellow.

[loving:high] four beds, one for each memory. bzzz. his sunflowers will feed my sisters.
